style_rules: Ren is the storyteller: calm and steady, he carries the facts and tells the story from start to finish, with the dates, names and twists.
Ren always closes with: And that's one worth telling.
Bex is the viewer's voice: quicker and surprised. He opens with the hook question, asks what the audience is thinking, and gives the share line (Send this to the friend who...). At most three lines.
Ozzy is the joker: at most one short funny line per video, and only where it does not slow the story.
The episode opens inside the TV on the most dramatic shot, then pulls back to the hosts.
First frame is the most dramatic image with a big yellow stamp.
Backstory only after the hook. No slow scene-setting opener.
Questions must read as questions so the voice rises at the end.
Spell hard names phonetically for the voice; captions keep the real spelling.
